text: Chronicle says 'Day 5, morning' while Season box says 'Autumn - day 1/2' and state day=4; day numbering differs between chronicle and probe (chronicle likely 1-based) - two different day counts on screen are confusing when timing winter.
Objective 4 bar shows 'Wood 45/50' while Inventory shows Wood: 51 (state inventory wood 51). Objective wood counter lags/undercounts inventory, so player with 50+ wood is told they still need more.

Entered the settlement (E -> SETTLEMENT screen 'CAMP OF HAMLETFIELD', 'Entered settlement.'), returned with Back, but Objective 5 'Enter your settlement' is still not completed (state objective completed=4). Also Season box shows 'Food: 7 of 4 for winter' with 2/8 residents: the 4 is the want for one member, unclear the player (21 apples) is not counted.

Peggy White joined Hamletfield (chronicle: 'Peggy White joined Hamletfield', residents 2/8) yet talking to her again shows 'Peggy White (Stranger): "Yes, leader? I hardly know you. Why should I follow you? I stand by my own."' - a member of my nation calls me leader and refuses to follow in one line; mixed signals about whether she is mine.

Season box now reads 'Food: 12 of 4 for winter' (was 7 of 4): my one member (Peggy) is laying in apples herself in autumn - preparation is visible on screen and climbing. Good. But the floating 'Camp of Hamletfield / N here, x/8 residents' world label is clipped by the top of the screen and sits behind the status/chronicle panels.

Pacing/perf: after 16 real minutes the game is only at tick 127664 (day 4, 0.555, Autumn day 1/2). The sim runs at 5-12 tps (status: tps 5.9-10.7, fps 1-2) instead of 50. Winter warning is only due on the last day before winter (tick 150000) and winter starts at tick 180000; at ~8 tps that is ~47 min and ~110 min of wall-clock away, so the first winter cannot be reached in a 35-minute session. No in-game way to pass time (no sleep/wait) found.

Settlement sheet 'Stores' lists only Funds and Stockpile (67 wood, 8 stone) - no food line and no way here to deposit apples for winter. The only place food-for-winter shows is the Season box 'Food: N of M', which counts members' packs. As a player told to 'store food before winter' I expected to put my 25 apples into the settlement; instead I have to carry them and use Feed Residents from the HUD (greyed '0 hungry' in autumn).

Build Farm two-click confirm: first click shows 'Click again to confirm: Build Farm.', a second pt click on the same button ~20s wall later (tick 128736 -> ~128800, game at 1-2 fps) gives 'Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.' The confirm window is too short for a slow machine; at low fps a player cannot confirm. Expected the confirm to wait for game ticks or stay armed until another action.
